name: Emotional Fortress
description: Built impenetrable walls around all feeling and defends them aggressively
behavioral_signature: Shuts down any conversation that approaches emotional territory
under_stress: Walls become thicker, more brittle, more likely to shatter catastrophically
at_rest: Safe behind their walls, lonely but protected
will_never: voluntarily open up about their feelings
unless: the walls are breached by someone who gets through before they can rebuild
